fields.description: Ist-Versteuerung is not supported yet.
fields.label: Taxation

fields.description: How far the tax booked in a voucher may differ from the tax on its bases in the Verprobung.
fields.label: Tolerance per Voucher

fields.description: By service date a Sales Invoice counts in the Voranmeldungszeitraum of its supply: the end of its billing period (To Date), else its start, else its latest Delivery Note. Credit notes, payments, Journal Entries and purchase invoices count by their posting date, and so do the accounts of Kz 41, 42 and 21, as in the Zusammenfassende Meldung. By posting date every booking counts on its posting date.
fields.label: Assignment to the Voranmeldungszeitraum
fields.options:
By Service Date
By Posting Date

fields.description: A booking made after the return of its period was filed stays in that period, which then needs a corrected return (Kz 10), or is reported in the period that was open when it was booked, within the same year. Every return records which applied.
fields.label: Documents for a Filed Period

fields.default: From the Base in Full Euros
fields.description: As booked, the tax of Kz 81, 86, 89 and 93 is the tax of the vouchers with its cents, so that Kz 83 equals the balance of the tax accounts; from the base, it is the rate times the base in full euros, as the official form computes it. The interface of the tax office accepts both.
fields.label: Tax on Turnover at a Statutory Rate
fields.options:
From the Base in Full Euros
As Booked

fields.description: A Kennzahl is conspicuous when it changes against the previous period by more than both thresholds. Conspicuous Kennzahlen get a hint and never hold the return.
fields.label: Previous Period Comparison

fields.description: Change in percent of the amount of the previous period.
fields.label: Comparison Threshold (%)

fields.description: Change in euros.
fields.label: Comparison Threshold (EUR)

fields.description: As issued by the Finanzamt, in the format of the Bundesland.
fields.label: Steuernummer

fields.description: 13 digits, derived from the Steuernummer and the Bundesland.
fields.label: ELSTER Steuernummer

fields.description: DE and nine digits, without the five-digit suffix, if the company has one.
fields.label: Wirtschafts-Identifikationsnummer

fields.description: The company's own German USt-IdNr., DE and nine digits, with which the USt-IdNrn. of its customers are confirmed. Empty: the Tax ID of the company, if it is one.
fields.label: VAT ID

fields.description: Calculate gives a hint on a USt-IdNr. behind Kz 41, 42 or 21 whose latest confirmation lies more days before the end of the Voranmeldungszeitraum. A hint never holds the return. The same age applies to a Sales Invoice behind Kz 21 and to the daily renewal.
fields.label: Maximum Age of a VAT ID Confirmation (Days)

fields.description: For the Zusammenfassende Meldung: the Teilnehmernummer the BZSt once assigned, seven or eight digits from 0300000 on. Empty: 1111111, since the BZSt assigns no new Teilnehmernummern.
fields.label: Teilnehmernummer of the BZSt
VAT ID Checks
fields.description: How Steuerbote confirms the USt-IdNrn. of customers and suppliers at the BZSt. Nothing is asked without the own USt-IdNr. above, and nothing by itself until a confirmation on a change or the daily renewal is switched on; the buttons on the partner and on the invoice work regardless. Agree the ages with the tax adviser: no law names a number of days.

Off by default. Confirm the USt-IdNr. of a partner in the background when the partner is created or its USt-IdNr., name or address changes; this sends the data of the partner to the BZSt, and to VIES when the BZSt cannot answer.
fields.label: Confirm When a Partner Changes

fields.description: Off by default. Every morning ask again about each partner whose latest confirmation is as old as the maximum age above or older, one after the other, at most 25 a day.
fields.label: Renew Confirmations Daily

fields.description: Confirm the USt-IdNrn. of suppliers from other member states as well. The law asks for those of customers; those of suppliers are a check of the master data.
fields.label: Confirm Suppliers

fields.description: Check the German USt-IdNrn. of partners at VIES of the European Commission, as a simple check of their validity without any comparison of name or address; the BZSt confirms no German numbers. Takes effect when the automatic check is on and on the buttons. It is not the confirmation of § 18e UStG.
fields.label: Check German VAT IDs

fields.description: What submitting a Sales Invoice behind Kz 41 or 42 does when the USt-IdNr. of the customer lacks a current valid confirmation. Block takes a written reason to submit all the same.
fields.label: Invoices for Goods (Kz 41, 42)

fields.description: The days a confirmation may lie before the posting date of an invoice behind Kz 41 or 42. 0: a confirmation of the day of the invoice.
fields.label: Maximum Age for Goods (Days)

fields.description: What submitting a Sales Invoice behind Kz 21 does when the USt-IdNr. of the customer lacks a current valid qualified confirmation; the maximum age above applies.
fields.label: Invoices for Services (Kz 21)

fields.description: Who files: the name, address and contact the files for ELSTER carry as Datenlieferant. Saving fills an empty field from the company and its address.
fields.label: Datenlieferant

fields.description: At most 45 characters. Empty: the name of the company.
fields.label: Name

fields.description: With the house number, at most 30 characters.
fields.label: Street and House Number

fields.description: For a company that starts with Steuerbote in the middle of its life: the Voranmeldungen before the books start were filed outside Steuerbote and are entered as VAT Return Prior Filings, see Start mit Steuerbote im laufenden Betrieb.
fields.label: Start in Steuerbote

fields.description: The first day of a month from which the books of the company in ERPNext are complete, the day of the opening balances. Steuerbote computes no Voranmeldung, Zusammenfassende Meldung or annual return for a period that begins before it. Empty when the books of every period are in ERPNext.
fields.label: Books Start

fields.description: Monthly, quarterly or none, from a year and month on until the next rule, as set by the Finanzamt.
fields.label: Filing Periods

fields.description: One row per year. Without a row, the deadlines of that year are not extended.
fields.label: Dauerfristverlängerung and Sondervorauszahlung

fields.description: Monthly, quarterly or yearly from a year and month on until the next rule (§ 18a UStG). The company follows the threshold of 50,000 euros and its Anzeigen to the BZSt; Calculate checks the threshold against the ledger.
fields.label: Rhythm of the Zusammenfassende Meldung

fields.description: The daily reminder of the deadlines not filed; the report Offene Fristen shows all of them.
fields.label: Deadlines

fields.description: E-mail addresses that get the reminder, one per line. Empty: no reminder is sent.
fields.label: Reminder Recipients

fields.description: The reminder names a deadline from this many days before it is due, and every day after until it is filed, also once it is overdue.
fields.label: Days of Notice
